content.short: Mutant Kongs is NFT project where people will compete for aftermarket sale royalties!
content.description:
Mutant Kongs - The battle for traded volume riches is NFT collection based on Cardano blockchain. There are 7 armies, which add up to the Mutant Kong kingdom's 999 inhabitants.

Each week, the armies compete to see who has the highest purchased floor. All armies compete in a battle for the traded volume riches!

The amount of traded volume determines the total reward amount for each week. The top three scoring armies will receive a total of 90% as prizes.
